channel.title: The Workshop Bench Podcast
channel.description: Short talks about hand tools and small repairs. A fixture podcast invented for this guide's lab; the "episodes" are one-second WAV tones the lab generated, standing in for real audio.

item.title: Episode 2: Choosing a hand plane
item.description: What the numbers on planes mean, why a number 4 suits most benches, and the two-minute sharpening routine that makes any plane behave.

item.title: Episode 1: The honest tape measure
item.description: Why the loose tip on a tape measure is a feature, how to burn an inch for accuracy, and when to stop measuring and start marking.
